caller history, native provider context and extra permissions are rejected before provider creation
conversation ownership and forged IDs reveal no other employee context
same-conversation request and clear lock while an investigation is in flight
only explicit host order metadata enters proposal; invoice date is never order date
approval text and execute actions cannot acquire any mutation capability
session history retains owner questions and lookup seeds, never live answers/native tool context
precise published workflow sources and exact canonical routes are available beside module summaries

current release corrections stay in the optional registry and preserve permission filtering
capability refusals have host evidence and cannot publish invented UI or actions

hydration retains only completed static display prose and never Job, failed or invoice results
history reauthorizes owner, base grant, source permissions, ancestry and changed knowledge before display
history checks source grants again after asynchronous proof checks

history holds the session lock, clear removes it, and successful hydration needs no provider or record reads
old workflow prose cannot substitute for new evidence and true clarification can remain tool-free
revoked source permission drops prior guidance before any model context is built
a changed published source drops prior guidance and a mid-turn source change blocks publication
derived walkthrough answers retain ancestor permissions and cannot survive their revocation
permission revocation during a turn stops the next retransmission of retained prose

knowledge walkthrough prose cannot cross owners or survive clear
final Job revocation clears result artifacts and measured model candidate prose
catalog changes after reasoning clear the prepared proposals and native candidate content
new duplicate appearing at publication clears prepared proposals
a later same-query catalog read cannot bless an earlier stale proposal
a later reread of the same Job cannot bless earlier inconsistent fact evidence
prepare grant revoked during final freshness check cannot publish the prior draft
operational grant revoked during final Job reread cannot publish prior facts
inventory preparation is absent when the employee lacks existing write/adjust grants
expired conversations cannot be revived by a caller-replayed ID
